name: ReadOut (local TTS)
head: Stalled audio detection released; Walter Focusrite output remains unresponsive
statusReason: PR 6 prevents indefinite playing status when audio callbacks stall. The published Windows package on Walter reported the stalled Focusrite output and reset to idle after Stop. Direct source tests completed normally on Realtek; the reason the selected Focusrite output does not respond remains unknown.

evidence.note: Local pytest pass on Python 3.12 (unit + e2e; PowerShell tool tests skipped on macOS). GitHub Actions tests and package-smoke runs were in progress at record time.

streamingPlayback.scope: Kokoro chunks play through a sounddevice OutputStream as the generator produces them; sentence-aware split in streaming mode; stop and cloud playback abort the live stream; save waits for synthesis so saved_to stays in the response.
streamingPlayback.verification: scripts/qa_streaming.py on commit 40e5c2f, 2026-10-26. Mac M4: 1.09 s start, 0 gaps. Walter i7-10875H Windows: 2.94 s, 0 gaps, 0 xruns. Dominic i7-7820HQ Linux: 3.73 s, 1 gap of 1 ms, 6 xruns. Stop at most 112 ms, and save was intact on all three. No human listened.
streamingPlayback.notDone: Duncan unmeasured (offline; Python 3.9 below Kokoro minimum). Dominic xruns not yet mitigated. Pause/resume, SSE, job queue and cloud streaming not started.
streamingPlayback.nextAction: Optional: measure Duncan once it is powered on with Python 3.12; try latency='high' if Linux clicks are audible.

windowsPackageStartup.diagnosis: On Walter the original Windows package did not listen without redirected streams, but started when either stream was redirected. Uvicorn logging fails on a missing standard stream.
windowsPackageStartup.verification: Walter Windows 11: downloaded published archive matched its release digest, started without redirected streams, reached ready, served /control, and reported one played audio chunk with zero underruns or xruns. Published executable SHA256 ed763ec7d64e09245f805d9711c9fc1752fc47c3012a6c308d28097a8dfdb04d. Merged revision tests and both hosted package smoke jobs passed.
windowsPackageStartup.remaining: Audible listener confirmation and full installed-app acceptance remain open. The historical main-latest prerelease was not changed.

audioCallbackStall.diagnosis: Walter Focusrite MME and DirectSound streams opened but did not deliver callbacks during a direct probe. Realtek MME completed the same silent stream. The underlying Focusrite or driver cause is unknown.
audioCallbackStall.verification: Walter: published archive checksum matched GitHub; packaged app started without output redirection and its control page included the error path. On the selected Focusrite output it reported state error with zero chunks played and the stopped responding message; Stop returned state idle. Source-level Realtek MME completed normally. 213 tests passed locally and hosted tests and both package smoke jobs passed.
audioCallbackStall.remaining: Focusrite device or driver cause, audible output on the published package and full installed-app acceptance remain unverified.

nextStep.title: Investigate Walter Focusrite output
nextStep.why: The selected output opens but does not deliver audio callbacks on the tested Windows paths.
nextStep.doneWhen: Identify and resolve the device or driver issue, then verify audible playback and normal completion in the published app.

findings.title: Audio device callback stall leaves playback active
findings.detail: The published app now detects missing callbacks, stops the stream and reports an audio-device error. The selected Focusrite output did not deliver callbacks; its device or driver cause is unknown.
findings.evidence: PR 6; release run 40460380215; Walter published-package retest, 2026-10-27

findings.title: Windowed Windows startup without console streams
findings.detail: PR 4 supplies missing output streams before initialization and publishes builds without force-updating tags. The published Windows package started without redirected streams on Walter; human listening and full installed-app acceptance remain open.
findings.evidence: PR 4; release run 40428601392; Walter published package runtime, 2026-10-26

findings.title: Streaming playback shipped on by default; verified on three machines
findings.detail: StreamPlayer and stream_chunks() in tts_engine.py. 100-character chunks fixed the start-of-read gap seen on slower CPUs. Results on 40e5c2f are in docs/BRIEF-streaming-playback.md. Device-open failures now return a 503 JSON error.

findings.title: ALSA xruns on Linux without a sound server
findings.detail: Dominic (raw ALSA, busy server) reported 6 driver underflows during a 226 s read. Candidate fix: OutputStream(latency='high'). Not yet measured as audible.

findings.title: ElevenLabs voice names are sent as voice ids
findings.detail: engines/elevenlabs.py passes catalogue names such as Rachel into the /v1/text-to-speech/{id} URL; only the hardcoded default id works. Fix is part of assessment item 19.

findings.title: Accelerator never selected for Kokoro
findings.detail: KPipeline is built without a device argument, so Apple Silicon runs on CPU despite PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK in main.py. Assessment item 10.

findings.title: 24 further assessment items proposed
findings.detail: Pause/resume, SSE, job queue, word timestamps/captions, compressed export, loudness, device selection, ONNX, cache, languages, blending, lexicon, preprocessing, hotkeys, extension a11y, shared-secret auth, cloud streaming, model distribution, telemetry, audio regression harness, pyproject/lint, signing/updates, document ingestion.

decisionsForDave: SP-1 [Answered C, 2026-10-26]: streaming playback on by default everywhere. Verified on Mac, Walter (Windows) and Dominic (Linux) after the chunking fix; Duncan unmeasured.

SP-2 [Open, 2026-10-26]: save semantics while streaming. A wait for synthesis so saved_to stays in the /speak response (implemented, recommended); B return at once and expose the path via /status. Unlocks whether /control needs a second poll.

RO-NEXT [Open, 2026-10-26]: next assessment item. A item 2 pause/resume/position (recommended; builds on 1, unlocks 3 and 5); B item 19 cloud streaming and the ElevenLabs voice-id fix; C item 18 shared-secret auth. Unlocks the next brief.
verify: python scripts/qa_streaming.py against a running daemon
context: Local-first desktop TTS (Kokoro on-device, OpenAI and ElevenLabs optional). FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:7778, Chrome extension, /control browser panel as the macOS UI.
